Class Transformable

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A type of object which can have osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms operating upon it. An implementer of this class must call osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transformable.UpdateTransforms to update and apply its osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms.

public abstract class Transformable : ITransformable, IDependencyInjectionCandidate, ISourceGeneratedDependencyActivator

Methods

AddTransform(Transform, ulong?)

Adds to this object a osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transform which was previously populated using this object via osu.Framework.Graphics.TransformableExtensions.PopulateTransform``3(``2,osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transform{``0,``1,``2},``0,System.Double,``1@). Added osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms are immediately applied, and therefore have an immediate effect on this object if the current time of this object falls within osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transform.StartTime and osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transform.EndTime. If osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transformable.Clock is null, e.g. because this object has just been constructed, then the given transform will be finished instantaneously.

ApplyTransformsAt(double, bool)

Applies osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transforms at a point in time. This may only be called if osu.Framework.Graphics.Transforms.Transformable.RemoveCompletedTransforms is set to false.

This does not change the clock time.
